title: Six-Storey Boutique Hotel Proposed in Kensington Market
summary: A Zoning By-law Amendment application has been submitted to the City of Toronto for a six-storey boutique hotel on Augusta Avenue in Kensington Market. Designed by Joel Gerber Architect for 1001216787 Ontario Inc, the proposal would replace two single-storey commercial buildings with a 43-room hotel along with restaurant, café, and retail spaces.

title: Scarborough Busway Prepares for September 30 Opening
summary: The TTC announced in August that the long-awaited Scarborough Busway will open for service on September 30th of this year. The bus-only roadway replaces the former Scarborough Rapid Transit (RT) Line 3 (a number that will now be reused by the Ontario Line when it opens some years from now), which was deemed too dangerous to continue operating in 2023 following a derailment linked to years of deferred maintenance. The busway will reuse much of the RT's former alignment, with new roadway replacing the track.
